description: Special inspection report for earthwork on a residential subdivision: the geotechnical firm's building-pad certification letter, the Field Density Summary Report of nuclear-gauge compaction tests, and the Soils Summary (Proctor moisture-density) sheets the tests are compared against.

certification_letter.description: The cover letter on page 1 that certifies the building pads.

letter_date.description: Date of the letter, as written (e.g. June 13, 2019).

client_name.description: Addressee/client company named at the top of the letter.

subject.description: The Re: line subject, e.g. Building Pad-Post-Tension Foundation.

project_description.description: The project/job line under Re:, e.g. the mass grading job and subdivision name.

lots_covered.description: The Lot #: line, including the phase in parentheses.

job_id.description: ProTeX Job ID# printed on the letter.

reference_number.description: Bracketed reference number printed at the right of the Re: line.

bearing_value_psf.description: Allowable bearing value assigned to the pads, in pounds per square foot, as a number.

foundation_type.description: Foundation system the bearing value is assigned for.

certification_period.description: How long the building pads are certified for, as stated.

engineer_name.description: Name of the registered professional engineer who signed the letter, as typed under the signature.

engineer_registration_number.description: Certificate number printed inside the engineer's seal.

registration_expires.description: Expiry date printed beneath the seal.

seal_date_signed.description: Date signed written across the seal.

is_sealed.description: True if a professional engineer's seal or stamp appears on the letter.

is_signed.description: True if the letter carries a signature.

field_density_report.description: The Field Density Summary Report table page.

test_type.description: Test Type: line above the table, e.g. Pad (5-10 feet) (Phase 1A).

tests.description: Every row of the compaction test table, in order.

lot.description: Lot / Sta. column, as printed (e.g. Lot 39).

depth_of_test.description: Depth of Test column, as printed (e.g. 7' BFG).

direct_transmission_used.description: Direct Trans. Used column, as printed (e.g. 10").

density_spec.description: Density Spec. (%) column, as printed (e.g. 98 min.).

moisture_spec.description: Moisture Spec. (%) column, as printed (e.g. -2 to +2).

proctor_lab_number.description: Proctor Lab # column: the lab number of the Proctor the test was compared against.

proctor_results.description: One entry per Soils Summary sheet, in page order.

lab_number.description: ProTeX Lab No, without the laboratory location (e.g. 191957).

lab_location.description: Laboratory location printed after the lab number.

test_method.description: Proctor test standard named above the Moisture Density panel (e.g. ASTM D698-A).

max_dry_density_pcf.description: Max. Dry Density in the Moisture Density (Proctor) panel.

liquid_limit.description: Liquid Limit in the Plasticity Index panel, as printed (NA if not tested).

expansion_index.description: EI = value in the Expansion Index panel, as printed.

remarks.description: Remarks: soil description at the bottom of the sheet.
